title.value: On diffusion models for amortized inference: Benchmarking and improving stochastic control and sampling
title.justification: The title is explicitly mentioned at the beginning of the paper.
title.quote: On diffusion models for amortized inference: Benchmarking and improving stochastic control and sampling

analysis.description: This paper explores the use of diffusion models for amortized inference, benchmarking existing stochastic control and sampling methods, and proposing a novel exploration strategy based on local search with a replay buffer. Diffusion models, as continuous-time stochastic processes, are used to gradually evolve a simple distribution into a complex target distribution. The paper introduces a unified library for diffusion-structured amortized inference methods, focusing particularly on off-policy methods and providing new modeling and training techniques for future research.

type.justification: The paper includes comprehensive benchmarks and experiments to evaluate various diffusion-structured samplers and methods for improving credit assignment and exploration strategies.
type.quote: We conduct comprehensive benchmarks of various diffusion-structured samplers, encompassing both GFlowNet samplers and methods such as PIS.
